properties.name: record_finding: recording a dated finding becomes a tool call, and the tool demands the root-cause skill by name
properties.rationale:
A FIFTH MECHANISM, not on the list that dec:idea-how-does-root-cause-become-automatic-rule-hook-detector-or-composition costed. That decision weighed four: a rule, a harness hook, an after-the-fact detector, and composition into other skills. Anthony took the rule, the detector and composition, and skipped the hook for two stated reasons — it reaches the wrong half, since a symptom-fix ships green with no failing command, and it reaches ONE HARNESS, because Alex's Grok Build TUI cannot take a hook.

A DEMAND FROM THE TOOL ITSELF ANSWERS THE SECOND OBJECTION WITHOUT INHERITING THE FIRST. A tool description is served by the MCP server to every client that connects, so it reaches every harness the way a hook cannot; and it fires on the WRITE rather than on a failure, so it reaches the case where nothing failed loudly — which is exactly the half the hook was rejected for missing. It is also the channel skill_lint already measured: over 91 sessions, where no tool demanded the matching skill, between 19 and 24 percent of sessions doing the work opened it.

THE OCCASION WAS A FAILURE OF THE SHIPPED LEGS. On 2026-09-07 the field-feedback rule was broken on a live report by the agent that had recorded its own enforcement ruling hours earlier. The rule was read and did not hold; the detector fires after the fact and did, as designed, but only later; composition did not reach a skill that was never loaded. Nothing reached the moment itself, because root-cause's trigger is the only one in the set defined by the agent's internal state rather than by an event. This makes that moment an event.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary:
A typed constructor for a TemporalFact. It takes the subject (which must resolve, so a finding about a node the design does not have is refused rather than stored), hangs the fact off it with HAS_TEMPORAL_FACT, and draws the CAUSES edge from `caused_by` with `cause_evidence` in the same call. Naming a cause without its evidence is refused before anything is written. The subject's type is resolved from the id, so the caller need not know it.

Its description tells the caller to fetch the root-cause skill before writing a cause, and getting-started/skills/root-cause/SKILL.md now declares `demanded_by: [record_finding]`, which tools/skill_lint.py enforces: the golden must exist and its description must name the skill. Step 8 of the skill points at this tool instead of at bare create_edge.

FAILING FIRST, OBSERVED: the demand was declared before the tool existed and skill_lint failed with "root-cause: names tool 'record_finding', which has no golden". The tool test's first assertion could not find the tool. Both pass now. Five tests in crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/recording_a_finding_is_a_tool_call_that_demands_the_skill.rs pin the demand contract rather than the tool's existence, so a rename may not quietly drop the sentence that makes the skill reachable.

IT ALSO CLOSES AN UNREACHABLE-VOCABULARY INSTANCE. Writing a TemporalFact had no typed constructor at all and went through generic create_node with a props bag, which is the class dev_storyflow reported the same day on two other properties.
